summary_en: Introduces a single-planar-matrix-array platform that co-registers 3D ultrasound localization microscopy perfusion maps with multispectral photoacoustic oxygenation maps. The platform is validated in vessel phantoms and in vivo in mice and provides complementary microvascular structure, perfusion and oxygenation information in the same volume.

summary_en: Develops computationally efficient PAT reconstruction formulations by establishing a connection between smoothing Matérn covariance priors and Sobolev embedding operators, then using wavelet-based implementations of the relevant adjoint operators to reduce compute and memory costs in deterministic and Bayesian reconstructions.
